function.name: grep
function.description: Search files with ripgrep (regex, Rust syntax). Returns structured file:line:text matches in content mode (default) or just matching paths in files mode. Respects .gitignore and skips hidden/binary files by default. A no-match result is NOT an error.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for (Rust regex syntax)

path.description: File or directory to search (default: current working directory)

glob.description: Glob filter for which files to search, e.g. '*.py'

mode.description: content = file:line:text matches (default); files = matching paths only

max_results.description: Hard cap on result lines before truncation (default 200, max 1000)
